title: Naming, style and lint
routing: Is this about what to call something or how code is written rather than what it does: identifier, file, route operationId or Prisma model/field names, polymorphic side names (owner/source/target/resource/subject/actor), util vs helper, make/validate/get/is prefixes, _ vs __ prefixes, imports (#/, @template/, barrels), comments, type vs interface, enums as const objects, named exports, no any, or the Biome/lint scripts and CI rules (check-import-aliases, no-prisma-maps, no-isarray-cast, no-create-race-machinery) that enforce them?
